title: upgrade-keys
description: What an agent release must be signed with, compiled into the agent (docs/spec/07-upgrade-channel.md): the public half of the release signing key, with room for one future key while the key is changed, and the code-signing publisher whose Authenticode signature every agent binary must carry. A publisher is trusted only when its certificate's common name and organization match exactly and its chain ends at the pinned root. Only a signed agent upgrade can change the agent's copy. An empty list means this build accepts no upgrades, and checks its own files against no one.

keyId.description: SHA-256 of the key's DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo, lower-case hex.

publicKey.description: Base64 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of an ECDSA P-256 key.

root.description: SHA-256 of the pinned root certificate (DER).
